implementation: Completed: bounded worker queue, six optional exports, contract checks, two exact neural outputs and two deferred errors.
design: Queue exclusively owns existing context after enable; worker is only caller of old/new synchronous processing, block legacy configure/process/hints while enabled. Lifecycle calls serial; Submit/Complete concurrent once enabled. Disable/contextdestroy cancel/drain before models released.

Fixed-capacity slot array allocated once, persistent worker. Submit checks capacity and validates descriptor copies before retain; no wait on inference or capacity. OWNERS acquired once at submit, snapshot callbacks held externally while worker receives borrowed copies, release before marking DONE.

Result states pending/finished/failed/cancelled + message per ticket, complete(nonblocking) optionalconsume onlyDONE. Completed but unconsumed slots count toward capacity; tickets never recycled across disable/re-enable for context. No model inference on full/invalid requests.

Drain optional cancelqueued/dropresults; running task finishes; reset derived views/IDs after seek. Resource callbacks outside heavy compute/mutex where safe; no reentry allowed. Unsupported external execution queue/fences fail, no fake GPU async.

Reuse qualified Surfacev1 validation and cached NN references; deterministic queue lifecycle tests using controlled barriers, actual short RIFE/SPAN output parity only as necessary. Preserve prior conclusive tests, no broad reruns.

Owner callbacks may execute on submit/worker/drain threads and must be thread-safe. Lifecycle enable/disable/destroy must exclude concurrent API access; ordinary Submit/Complete can be concurrent while queue lives. CPU dependency mask only NONE, no native GPU fence proof.
